caveat: Categories only. No colour, clarity or turbidity: illumination dominates the pixels and depth is not visible in a photograph. Counts are of what is VISIBLE, which is a lower bound.

records.notable: Water strongly opaque tan-brown across the whole frame, including shaded areas.
records.notes: Under a CLEAR sky, so a merely reflective surface would read blue. This is the water’s own colour. Cause not determinable from a photograph — sediment, tannin and an algal tint all look like this. Also the largest goose count of the year (8-12); whether that is coincidence or connected is not answerable here.
records.model: Claude Opus 5, exhaustive visual sweep of all 262 photos
